title: Pet Clinic settings
description: Working hours for the urgent-concern review deadline, and Google Calendar access for appointment sync.

timeZone.title: Clinic time zone
timeZone.description: Time zone ID, for example Europe/Berlin or America/New_York.

googleClientId.title: Google OAuth client ID
googleClientId.description: From the Google Cloud OAuth client (…apps.googleusercontent.com).

googleRefreshToken.title: Google refresh token
googleRefreshToken.description: Created with scripts/google-calendar-auth.mjs after signing in with the clinic calendar account.

googleCalendarId.title: Google Calendar ID
googleCalendarId.description: Calendar that holds the appointments. Use 'primary' for the signed-in account's main calendar.
